problem: Normal context disposal could interrupt an admitted native capability record. A preceding unchanged TodoMVC discovery attempt left active=1 and completed=2 despite browser exit zero, correctly invalidating its recording.
mechanism: An opt-in shared lock on the original journal-state file spans native record admission, source capture and commit. Browser-owned child termination takes an exclusive lock and retains it until a pidfd observes that exact process exiting. Renderer IO-disconnect and main-thread immediate-exit paths take the same exclusive lock and retain it until process exit. New writers cannot enter between drain and termination. Existing recording validity checks remain unchanged.
decision: Retain the guarded private recorder for this tested multiprocess Linux headless-shell policy. The selected application refresh and repeated four-worker discovery gate pass. Do not treat this as public capability delivery, production IPC or a performance result.

limitations: The first guard failed the deterministic control because renderer self-exit bypassed browser-owned termination. That candidate, executable and original failed run are retained separately.

One forced-kill control initially expected only an unfinished-record error. The existing abnormal-renderer protection instead terminated the browser, also invalidating the recording. The corrected control permits either verified failure cause and does not admit a killed writer.

Missing or damaged journals and original failed termination remain invalid. The shared completion counters and original browser wait were not relaxed; forced-kill and stalled-writer controls remain rejected.

These guards cover the selected ordinary multiprocess Linux headless-shell paths. Sanitizer builds, single-process mode, alternate keep-child-after-IPC-reset behavior, arbitrary signal interruption, other process exit paths and other platforms are not admitted.
The append-lock fault controls verify bounded observed failure without watchdog cleanup. They do not establish universal native shutdown latency or lock fairness under every workload.

Original process waits, completed counters and observed group drain are verified. The 100ms sampler misses some control writers. Direct live group/mapping checks select held writers, but standalone stat/map receipts were not saved. Exhaustive custody and final resource admission remain open.
Fresh browser per attempt and no-sandbox file recording are private diagnostic policies. No previous paint or preparation timing applies automatically to this executable.

Remaining painting/capture dependencies, other storage, network exclusions, complete discovery, public runner integration and production IPC remain unfinished. Representative majority-scenario 2x performance, complete competitor admission and release remain unproven.
